standards.description: Fields exist between objects exerting force; electric circuits are driven by a potential difference.
standards.traceDetail: The battery bank's potential difference is the push setting charges in motion.

standards.standard: Conservation of Energy and Energy Transfer
standards.description: Energy moves via the electric current that voltage drives through the bulb.
standards.traceDetail: Each added volt increases the bulb's energy transfer rate, shown as brighter glow.

standards.description: Macroscopically, current in circuits arises from a potential difference; voltage is that difference.
standards.traceDetail: Stacking cells demonstrates additive potential difference and its effect on current.
